gloss_en: the 'staff of strength' (mateh oz, Psalms 110:2) — the forceful, judgment-charged prayer of the spiritually mighty person (baal koach), which lodges in the throat of the Sitra Achra forcing it to disgorge the swallowed holiness of Da'at, subdues Amalek, and reveals the Divine glory (Likutey Moharan II:8); מַטֵּה = staff (not מִטָּה, bed)
